data.narrative:
Blykalla is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos that has raised $60M+. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 11 peers: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

The peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient narrow comparables—while 5 same-sector peers exist, only one operates at the same stage and one at an adjacent stage, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum needed for reliable triangulation. A stage-progression methodology is therefore the primary applicable approach. Using the $60M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression yields $114M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $97M to $131M, centered on $114M. The median estimate reflects disciplined stage-based advancement of deployed capital; the range captures uncertainty inherent in a single-method valuation. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight-filter peer data for nuclear venture positions at this stage, and the limited visibility into Blykalla's proprietary technology, capital efficiency, and deployment timeline relative to its peer set. Further diligence on comparable funding terms and burn profile would reduce range width.
